content.text:
The drawing shows a biphenyl: two benzene rings joined by a single bond between one carbon of each ring. Each ring carries a tBu label at the position directly opposite the biaryl bond (para). Expanding tBu to C(C)(C)C gives 4,4'-di-tert-butylbiphenyl.

SMILES: CC(C)(C)c1ccc(cc1)-c1ccc(cc1)C(C)(C)C
